card.title: You Handle the Evidence
card.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you explain my missing magician's receipt to the treasurer? You booked him.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You paid him. I only found his number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then ring him for a replacement. You've got the number.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He won't send a duplicate unless the treasurer emails him directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then draft her email and get her to send it. Copy yourself in so you can chase him.

mechanism: A turns every correction about responsibility into another route for B to handle the missing receipt.
confusable: Unlike asking B merely to start a hard conversation, A keeps transferring the specific evidence and follow-up chain.
comparison: No physical object can be handed over; A assigns contact, drafting and chasing instead of cashbox custody.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
